posts.title: 2026 W45: Dreamlike and comedic
posts.description: § Last Sunday I stopped by the Apple Store to check out the new iPhone Duo. It seems really fun and the hardware feels great. It is also really expensive! I would be lying if I said I don’t feel an annoying urge to buy one.
